mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals severe labor market distress that triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 105.0 index level signals robust manufacturing output expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that prompt monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive monthly declines in retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer spending momentum that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase (UNRATE) and employment decline (PAYEMS) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending capacity and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 90.0 index level indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces economic growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
